purpose: The one list of admin commands. scripts/admin/run_admin_command.mjs dispatches from it, and .github/workflows/admin-command.yml gates its commit step on the read_only set. Neither may keep a private copy: VAL-ADMIN-COMMAND-VERIFY-LANE asserts the two agree.
read_only_note: verify proves the workflow is reachable and internally consistent without touching main. __parse_probe__ is the historical name an audit dispatched on 2026-08-29 (run 33274444603); it is kept as an alias so that recorded name resolves instead of throwing.
